title: The Global T20 Nomad: DA Miller's Journey Across 9 Leagues
summary: DA Miller has played in 9 T20 leagues (BBL, BPL, CPL, IPL, LPL), scoring 8325 runs at 33.7.
body:
## 9 Leagues, One Mission

DA Miller is one of T20 cricket's true globetrotters. From the IPL to the BBL, from the CPL to the PSL, he's plied his trade across **9 different T20 leagues**: BBL, BPL, CPL, IPL, LPL, MLC, PSL, SA20, T20I.

**Career Numbers:** 8325 runs | 370 innings | Avg 33.7 | SR 138.5

That kind of cross-league experience shapes a player. Different pitches, different pressure, different tactical demands — and Miller has delivered across all of them.

---
*Data across 9 T20 leagues. Analysis by MatchPrism.*
